about.title: ABOUT
about.subtitle: Chronicles of Cinematic Darkness
about.siteDescription1: Welcome to the dark archives of classic fantasy cinema. This site is dedicated to exploring the gothic masterpieces that shaped the horror imagination of the 20th century.
about.siteDescription2: From Universal Studios to Hammer Productions, passing through Italian and Spanish-Mexican creations, we unearth the legendary creatures that continue to haunt our screens and nightmares.
about.siteQuote: Monsters never truly die. They simply wait in the shadows, ready to resurface for a new generation of viewers...
about.siteDescription3: Join us in this exploration of shadows, where each article reveals a new chapter in the history of classic horror cinema.
